description:
Positive Morning Music | Sitar Instrumental | 1.5 Hours

Before the calls. Before the inbox. Before anyone needs anything from you.

Some mornings start clean. Others take a while to get there. This is for the second kind — the ones where you need something quiet before the day picks up pace.

90 minutes of slow Sitar. No vocals, no percussion, no build-up. Just the instrument, long unhurried phrases, and enough space between the notes to actually breathe. The music moves at a pace the mind can follow without effort — nothing sharp, nothing urgent. Just a steady open sound that makes the first hour feel a little softer.

Put it on while you get ready, have your coffee, or sit quietly before it all starts. You don't need to listen actively. Let it run, and notice how differently the morning settles around you when there is something this calm playing underneath it.

Each piece has been crafted with care — time spent choosing melodies that feel genuinely open and forward-moving, refined until the experience feels smooth from the first note to the last.

A quiet Alpha wave layer sits underneath at low volume, gently supporting an alert and clear state of mind as the day begins.

Good for slow starts, morning brain fog, getting into a positive headspace before work, or anyone who needs a quiet moment before the world gets loud.

Press play, take a breath, and let your morning unfold at its own pace.

0:00 First notes
15:00 Warming up
35:00 In the flow
60:00 Steady energy
80:00 Settled and ready

If this brought you a good start to your day, feel free to like, share, or subscribe for more daily music.

— Raga Focus

thumbnail_prompt: Pichwai/Kangra miniature painting style, ornate gold-and-cream patterned border with subtle lotus and sunrise motifs, aged warm parchment background, early morning palette (golden light, pale amber sky, warm cream). Central figure: calm man in white and gold kurta seated cross-legged playing sitar (long-necked plucked instrument with gourd base, resting diagonally on the lap) on a rooftop or open courtyard, first light of morning washing over him, birds suggested in the distance. Expansive sky behind, sense of quiet before the day starts. Bold dark-teal serif overlay text reading 'START STRONG' top-center, traditional Devanagari-influenced serif typography, high contrast for mobile readability. Warm golden-cream parchment palette, energised yet calm mood, single composed scene, no clutter.
suno_prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Bright sitar solo in raga Bhupali, morning energy mood, clear articulate plucked notes with natural resonance, no percussion, no tabla, 432Hz tuning, 70-80 BPM moderate tempo, flowing melodic phrases with confident forward movement, mid register (warm and resonant, not sharp or harsh), cinematic meditation production, positive and uplifting without being aggressive, suitable for extended looping. Raga Bhupali tonic C or G — pentatonic, open, optimistic. Emotionally: like the feeling of a morning that's going to go well — clear, calm, ready. Alpha wave layer at -20dB, very subtle. Not sleepy, not hyper — settled positive energy.

production_spec.loop_seam: 10s in / 30s out, Suno extend 3-4x → loop in post to fill 90 min
production_spec.notes: Raga Bhupali — pentatonic morning raga, Sa Re Ga Pa Dha. Bright and open without being jarring. Sitar should feel resonant and warm, mid-register — not the high bright sitar of Dopamine Reset. Alpha 10Hz for alert calm. LUFS -14 (morning audience is awake). EMOTIONAL TAG ROTATION: clip 1: 'clear and optimistic, like a morning already going well' · clip 2: 'warm and ready, like the first confident breath of the day' · clip 3: 'settled and forward-moving, like walking into something good'. Reference ship: Morning Motivation Sitar (May 16) — 8.2K views, 4.62% CTR, 26.88% AVD. Match that energy.

experiment_notes:
Test 23 — FORMAT WAR: SEO-stacked pipes vs natural connector phrasing.

Context: 70% of channel traffic comes from YouTube recommendations (browse feed), not search. Keyword-stacked pipes optimise for search. Natural connector phrasing ('Sitar Music to Start Your Morning Right') reads more like a recommendation — may perform better in browse where CTR hook matters more than keyword density.

If A wins: SEO-stacked format is robust even in browse-dominant distribution — keep using it.
If B wins: Natural connector format outperforms in browse feed — shift title philosophy away from rigid pipes for future ships. Major channel-level finding.

Secondary: Sitar in morning lane — replicating May 16 Morning Motivation success. If this clears 8K views, morning lane is confirmed as a Sitar pillar (2/2 ships). Can build 1 Sitar morning ship every 3-4 weeks.

FAILURE MODE: <3K views or <22% AVD — morning Sitar not replicable, May 16 was anomaly.
SUCCESS: 8K+ views + 4%+ CTR — Sitar morning pillar confirmed.
BREAKTHROUGH: B wins AND 8K+ views — natural connector format validated, reshape title approach.
